title: ANSYS Fluent – Fluid Flow & Streamline Simulation
summary: A CFD simulation demonstrating internal fluid flow using ANSYS Fluent. The project focuses on analysing velocity contours, streamlines, and pressure distribution to understand flow behaviour and verify proper simulation setup.
problem: Predict the behavior of fluid flowing through a computational domain and visualize important flow characteristics such as velocity, pressure, and streamlines.
solution: Created the geometry, generated a computational mesh, applied inlet and outlet boundary conditions, solved the flow field using ANSYS Fluent, and analyzed velocity contours and streamlines to evaluate flow performance.
